note: Published FiR 1 / BPA-F uncertainty budget encoded as discrete scenarios. Anchors: Savolainen et al. (Acta Oncol) — 6% total 1σ decomposed to MCNP model 2.3%, patient geometry 3.9%, distance 3.3%, calibration 1.5%, blood boron ±20%, skin = 1.5×blood; Kotiluoto et al. — 8% total computational 1σ excluding boron. Values are ±1σ worst cases, not distributions.
